LightningComponentBundle.description: Upload POC notes files (PDF, Office, images, text) for a Contact. Outputs Content Document Id for Flow.

property.name: recordId
property.label: Record ID (Contact)
property.description: Optional Contact Id to link the uploaded file to (FirstPublishLocationId).

property.name: titleGrad
property.label: Title (gradient part)
property.description: Second heading segment with accent styling.

property.name: hintText
property.label: Hint text
property.default: Upload a file for this contact's POC notes (PDF, Word, images, etc.). The file is stored in Salesforce Files.

property.name: fileTitle
property.label: File title (optional)
property.description: Title stored in Salesforce Files. Defaults to the original file name.

property.name: requireUploadBeforeNext
property.label: Require upload before Next
property.description: When true, the Flow Next control stays disabled until an upload succeeds.

property.name: contentDocId
property.label: Content Document Id
property.description: Output: ContentDocument Id after upload. Map to a Flow Text variable.
